// record 0057: 'a // b' FLOORS, where C++'s '/' truncates toward zero.
// The two differ exactly when the signs differ and the division is not exact
static int64_t __floor_div_i(int64_t a, int64_t b) {

}

// the same over a float, which is the floor of the quotient
static double __floor_div_f(double a, double b) {

}
